fusions.name: Swooping Pounce
fusions.desc: Leaps at a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 30 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full range. When it lands, every ally near you deals 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Flush the Covey
fusions.desc: Barks 3 gusts at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 wind damage. You have 25% more critical hit chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Light on the Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Tailwind Lope
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and you have 15% wind resistance.
